Sokoni Freight Carrier Agreement (starte:
Sokoni Freight Carrier Agreement (starter text — have a lawyer review before launch):

1. You are a duly registered transport business holding all licences, permits and insurance required for the modes and countries you operate in.
2. Quotes you submit are binding offers if accepted. You are responsible for the cargo from pickup to delivery, including temperature control where promised.
3. You will provide accurate status updates and the transport documents (e.g. bill of lading, airway bill or consignment note) the shipper needs.
4. You are responsible for customs formalities assigned to you under the agreed Incoterm, and for complying with the laws of each country on the route.
5. Sokoni is a marketplace, not a carrier or customs broker, and is not liable for freight loss, delay or damage.
6. You are an independent business responsible for your own taxes.
Sokoni Local Rider Agreement (starter te:
Sokoni Local Rider Agreement (starter text — have a lawyer review before launch):

1. You hold any licence/permit required for your vehicle and it is roadworthy and insured.
2. You collect produce only at the pickup point shown and deliver it to the drop-off shown, without detours that damage the goods.
3. You are responsible for goods in your possession between pickup and delivery and will report damage or loss immediately.
4. Sokoni may deactivate accounts for unsafe conduct, repeated non-delivery or false location reporting.
5. You are an independent contractor responsible for your own taxes and licences.
